scripts.build:cloudflare: pnpm check:cloudflare:ci && pnpm check:cloudflare:targets && pnpm check:cloudflare:release && pnpm check:cloudflare:deployment-verifier && pnpm check:cloudflare:dev-host && pnpm check:cloudflare:services && pnpm check:cloudflare:rpcs && pnpm check:cloudflare:worker-runners && pnpm check:cloudflare:moderation-score && pnpm check:cloudflare:conquest-gate && pnpm check:cloudflare:leaderboard-gate && pnpm check:cloudflare:offchain && pnpm check:cloudflare:reward-producers && pnpm check:cloudflare:reward-mutators && pnpm check:cloudflare:chain-effects && pnpm check:cloudflare:mint-queues && pnpm check:cloudflare:reward-visibility && pnpm check:cloudflare:browser-transactions && pnpm check:cloudflare:webapp-routes && pnpm check:cloudflare:auth-mode && pnpm check:cloudflare:locales && pnpm check:cloudflare:reward-readiness && pnpm check:cloudflare:typecheck && pnpm check:cloudflare:browser-code && pnpm check:cloudflare:main-worker && pnpm check:cloudflare:multiplayer && pnpm check:cloudflare:analytics && node ./utils/build-cloudflare.mjs
scripts.check:cloudflare:typecheck: pnpm --filter @opensky/cloudflare typecheck && pnpm --filter @opensky/cloudflare-game-server --filter @opensky/cloudflare-match-service --filter @opensky/cloudflare-matchmaker --workspace-concurrency=1 typecheck && pnpm --filter @opensky/game-analytics typecheck:cloudflare
scripts.check:cloudflare:browser-code: pnpm --filter @opensky/webapp type-check && pnpm --dir game exec tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck && pnpm --filter @opensky/game test
scripts.preview:cloudflare: pnpm build:cloudflare && pnpm --dir cloudflare exec wrangler dev --config ../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm build:cloudflare && node ./utils/run-cloudflare-production.mjs deploy wrangler.jsonc && pnpm verify:cloudflare:deployment
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:game-server: pnpm check:cloudflare:offchain && pnpm check:cloudflare:targets && pnpm --filter @opensky/cloudflare-game-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @opensky/cloudflare-game-server test && node ./utils/run-cloudflare-production.mjs deploy game-server-cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:match-service: pnpm check:cloudflare:conquest-gate && pnpm check:cloudflare:targets && pnpm --filter @opensky/cloudflare-match-service typecheck && pnpm --filter @opensky/cloudflare-match-service test && node ./utils/run-cloudflare-production.mjs deploy match-service-cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:matchmaker: pnpm check:cloudflare:release && pnpm check:cloudflare:targets && pnpm --filter @opensky/cloudflare-matchmaker typecheck && pnpm --filter @opensky/cloudflare-matchmaker test && node ./utils/run-cloudflare-production.mjs deploy matchmaker-ts/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:analytics: pnpm --filter @opensky/game-analytics typecheck:cloudflare && pnpm check:cloudflare:analytics && pnpm check:cloudflare:targets && node ./utils/run-cloudflare-production.mjs deploy game-analytics/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:cloudflare:local: pnpm --dir cloudflare exec wrangler d1 migrations apply opensky-auth --local --config ../wrangler.jsonc
